verdict.rationale: LightSprint's task board, Slack/Linear/Jira task intake and background bug-fixing agents are adjacent features. Nothing in the evidence shows incoming issues being automatically triaged, given a suggested severity, or routed to an owner. Creating tasks from trackers and having agents clear a bug backlog is intake and execution, not triage or routing.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have incoming issues automatically triaged with severity suggested and routed to the right owner
